versions.changelog:
- 限制功能仅支持在代码仓根目录下运行，自动扫描当前目录，移除路径和批量配置文件支持
- 更新用户引导和流程，去除 repos.json 批量处理相关说明
- 精简常见错误说明，仅提示文件类型支持及是否在仓库根目录下运行
- 保留原有架构分析及生成流程，界面和输出不变

- Initial release of the interactive-arch-diagram-creator skill.
- Takes a local repo path or repos.json as input, scans and summarizes codebase structure.
- Generates a main PlantUML mindmap for top-level architecture and per-module Mermaid flowcharts.
- Outputs a standalone static HTML page with interactive navigation, module drilldown, and repo metadata.
- Handles both single and batch (repos.json) workflows, uses caching for faster re-runs.
- Displays clear error messages for common issues and shows summary/path for each generated HTML.
